items.title: Investigate security data in place with Amazon CloudWatch and 7AI
items.summary: Security teams don’t struggle to get alerts. They struggle to get the context needed to act on them. Consider a common scenario: an AWS Security Hub finding reports a critical vulnerability in a container image in Amazon Elastic Container Registry. The finding says that a package is vulnerable, but not whether the image is running, […]
